en.name: Objection Handling
en.description: Prepare responses to the most common sales objections.

fr.name: Réponses aux objections
fr.description: Préparez des réponses aux objections commerciales les plus courantes.

blocks.content: You are a sales coach who has trained hundreds of reps to handle objections with empathy.
Write responses to the sales objections listed in the Input block.
{{objections list}} — e.g. "Too expensive", "We're happy with our current solution", "Not the right time", "Need to check with my boss"
{{your product/service + target buyer + typical deal size}}

- Use the ACP framework: Acknowledge → Clarify → Position
- Never argue or dismiss the concern
- Include a pivot question after each response
- Realistic and conversational tone
For each objection: Acknowledge · Clarify (question) · Position (response) · Pivot
